//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	privatehttp "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/generatedcourse"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root prepares and launches this finite helper. No Course is precreated:
// Planner must call the registered generated-course handler and actual Ensure.
// The fixture authored document belongs to the composer, not this provider.
func TestT19ServePlanningCourseHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T19_SERVE_COURSE") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T19 Course provider gate absent")
	}
	ready, stop, result := os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_RESULT_FILE")
	token := os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_TOKEN")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t19_course_test" || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998 || token == "" || ready == "" || stop == "" || result == "" || ready == stop || ready == result || stop == result {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owned Course configuration required")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{ready, stop, result} {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: metadata and stop paths must be absent")
		}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Course pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var database string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&database) != nil || database != cfg.ConnConfig.Database {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact Course database unavailable")
	}
	var count int
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM code_structure_type WHERE code='QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC'`).Scan(&count) != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Course quiz reference missing")
	}
	for _, language := range []string{"ru", "en"} {
		if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM i18n WHERE language=$1`, language).Scan(&count) != nil || count != 1 {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: Course language reference missing")
		}
	}
	// Refuse a prior provider run rather than adopting its authored state.
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM generated_course`).Scan(&count) != nil || count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: generated Course fixture namespace must be empty")
	}
	lessons, translations, tasks, examples := LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}, LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}, LessonExampleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	revisions := lessonrevision.Definitions{Revisions: LessonRevisionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Lessons: lessons, Translations: translations, Tasks: tasks, Tests: TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Files: TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Examples: examples, Tx: LessonRevisionTxPG{Pool: pool}}
	ensure := generatedcourse.Ensure{
		Revisions: revisions, Generated: GeneratedCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Courses: CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseI18n: CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Modules: ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleI18n: ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseModules: CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Sections: SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, SectionI18n: SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleSections: ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: translations, SectionLessons: SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Examples: examples,
		Tasks: tasks, TaskI18n: TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskTargets: TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool},
		StructureTypes: CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}, I18n: I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Tx: TxManagerPG{Pool: pool}, IDs: t19CourseIDs{}, Clock: t19CourseClock{},
	}
	registered := chi.NewRouter()
	registered.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(
		&privatehandlers.TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks}, GetDetailsUC: task.GetTaskDetails{Tasks: tasks, TaskTests: TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskFiles: TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool}, LearningTargets: TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Structures: CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}}},
		&privatehandlers.LessonHandler{GetUC: lesson.GetLesson{Lessons: lessons}, RevisionsUC: revisions}, nil, &privatehandlers.GeneratedCourseHandler{Ensure: ensure}, token, token, ""))
	state := func(readCtx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) {
		value := map[string]any{"database": database, "classification": "actual registered Course Ensure, hierarchy, revisions and PostgreSQL; composer supplies synthetic authored fixture; no LLM or NATS"}
		counts := map[string]int64{}
		for _, table := range []string{"generated_course", "generated_course_request", "generated_lesson", "generated_course_revision_receipt", "lesson_revision"} {
			var n int64
			if err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, `SELECT count(*) FROM `+table).Scan(&n); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			counts[table] = n
		}
		value["counts"] = counts
		for key, query := range map[string]string{
			"generated_courses":  `SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('course_id',course_id,'fingerprint',course_fingerprint,'fingerprint_version',fingerprint_version,'plan',plan_json) ORDER BY course_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM generated_course`,
			"generated_requests": `SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'request_hash',request_hash,'course_id',course_id,'reused',reused) ORDER BY idempotency_key),'[]'::jsonb) FROM generated_course_request`,
		} {
			var raw json.RawMessage
			if err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, query).Scan(&raw); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			value[key] = raw
		}
		return value, nil
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /__t19/state", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		readCtx, finish := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
		defer finish()
		value, err := state(readCtx)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "state unavailable", 500)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
	})
	mux.Handle("/", registered)
	server := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(mux)
	server.Config.ReadHeaderTimeout, server.Config.ReadTimeout, server.Config.WriteTimeout, server.Config.IdleTimeout = 5*time.Second, 40*time.Second, 40*time.Second, 5*time.Second
	server.Start()
	defer server.Close()
	defer server.CloseClientConnections()
	value, err := state(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: initial Course state unavailable")
	}
	value["url"] = server.URL
	t19CourseWriteExclusive(t, ready, value)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owned Course 20-minute deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stop); err == nil {
				value, err := state(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal("owned final Course state unavailable")
				}
				value["url"] = server.URL
				t19CourseWriteExclusive(t, result, value)
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("owned Course stop read failed")
			}
		}
	}
}

func t19CourseWriteExclusive(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Course metadata encoding failed")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path+".tmp", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive Course metadata creation failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil || os.Link(path+".tmp", path) != nil || os.Remove(path+".tmp") != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive atomic Course metadata publication failed")
	}
}

type t19CourseIDs struct{}

func (t19CourseIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type t19CourseClock struct{}

func (t19CourseClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }
